mail-2.subject: DevCon Seattle: speaker check-in and AV details
mail-2.body:
Hi Carol,

Thanks for confirming your talk, "Twelve minutes: what INC-4 taught us about replay". Speaker check-in is at the Pike St entrance from 08:00 on day one. Please bring your laptop with HDMI or USB-C; we have clickers but not adapters.

Slides are due 48 hours ahead so we can load them on the backup machine. The room seats 320 and is usually full for the reproducibility track.

Helena Marsh
Programme, DevCon Seattle

mail-3.subject: Re: DevCon Seattle: speaker check-in and AV details
mail-3.body:
Hi Helena — confirmed, I will bring USB-C. Slides will be with you tomorrow; the talk is the INC-4 postmortem with the timeline redrawn as a replay, so nothing that needs sound.

Carol

mail-4.subject: Dad's knee — surgery date
mail-4.body:
Carol,

The consultant has Dad down for the knee replacement on Wednesday 14 October, first thing. I will take him in; can you cover the Friday and the weekend after? He is pretending it is nothing, obviously.

Mum says do not bring flowers, bring the crossword.

Ken

mail-5.subject: Re: Dad's knee — surgery date
mail-5.body:
Friday 16th and the weekend, yes — I will book the Friday off now. Tell him I am bringing the hard crossword, not the easy one.

C

mail-7.subject: Harborline Coffee: the back room is open for bookings again
mail-7.body:
The back room reopens this month after the floor was redone. It seats twelve, has its own door, and is free to book with a $60 minimum spend. Reply to this email or ask at the counter.

Also new: the oat-milk cortado you all kept asking for, and Saturday hours to 18:00.
